name: Vaclav Gaidar
original_name: ヴァーツラフ・ガイダル
source:
The leader of the trading company which bears his name, he is highly calculating and will sacrifice anything to achieve his aims. His company frequently engages in criminal activity like assassinations and kidnapping away from the public eye.

[Spoiler] His trading company is just a cover for his real position as the last pure-blood descendant of the group of humans who rebelled against the rule of the gods centuries ago. His organisation 魔シキ封錬の匠 comprises the human descendants of the rebels who developed the technology to imprison gods and spirits to harness their divine power to operate mobile fortresses. The group prizes the importance of bloodline as it unlocks the key to retaking control of extant fortresses with bound gods. As Avaro's human heritage bears the same blood which freed Fia from her bounds, Gaidal schemes to manipulate Fia into a position where he can seize control of the Guaracouna fortress away from Avaro. [/Spoiler]
